text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO ALERT — realtime.streaming.generate p99 > 4.0s in us-east-1 (5m window). Breach rate: 2.3%. Pager routed to sally-oncall. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/streams?p=us-east-1&alert=1777312468

sally-oncall: taking this — joining bridge. Any customer reports yet? :eyes:

lina-support: support: seeing 2 escalations from customers A and B, both mention session timeouts while streaming. CS notified, I'm pulling logs now.

jamar-sre: looking at infra graphs — streaming worker tail latency spike aligns with higher GPU queue length and a KV cache miss spike around 15:04. 90th-99th tail concentrated on node pool stream-worker-highmem-2.

arjun-runtime: fwiw we pushed a model variant rollout 7m ago (v2-quantized -> 10% traffic). Telemetry shows v2 p95 is fine but p99 tail jumps on longer contexts. Possible regression in kv cache reuse.

sally-oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) pause or roll back rollout, 2) shift traffic off the affected pool, 3) enable burst capacity. Jamar/arjun can you confirm feasibility?

deploy-bot: rollback command queued: rollback rollout-id=rl_20260317_1736 (v2 -> v1). Estimated time to completion: ~2m.

jamar-sre: scaling up stream-worker replicas by +3 to reduce queueing. Running:
```
kubectl -n streaming scale deployment/stream-worker --replicas=12
```

arjun-runtime: enabling fallback routing for streaming.generate to fallback-model-group (non-quantized) for 5% traffic now. Also toggling KV cache conservative mode: prefix_cache.enabled=true

ops-bot: snapshot: logs collected to https://logs.redwood/snapshots/1777312468  (auto-attach)

sally-oncall: lina — customer impact? estimate percent of total requests affected?

lina-support: CS: looks like ~4% of calls for the last 10m from EU + US customers; two enterprise tenants had timeouts >10s. Drafting a heads-up for affected customers, want to wait until rollback stabilizes.

arjun-runtime: short log snippet from affected host:
```
[2026-03-17T15:04:23Z] host=stream-worker-7 tail_latency=5.2s kv_miss_rate=0.42 queue_len=38 model=v2-quantized
[2026-03-17T15:04:29Z] host=stream-worker-7 tail_latency=6.1s kv_miss_rate=0.45 queue_len=41 model=v2-quantized
```

jamar-sre: rollback in progress, traffic shifting off v2. Also marking node pool for investigation (possible noisy neighbor or kernel update).

deploy-bot: rollback complete: rollout-id=rl_20260317_1736 -> state=rolled_back. Traffic to v2 now 0%.

sally-oncall: seeing immediate improvement on the p99 panel — dropping from ~5.8s to ~2.1s in the last 90s. Keep watches for next 10m.

arjun-runtime: KV miss rate trending down after traffic shift. We'll keep fallback routing for 5 more minutes and then remove if stable.

lina-support: CS updated — will send customer heads-up in 10m if metrics hold. Marked 3 tenants for priority follow-up.

jamar-sre: filing follow-up incident ticket: INF-2026-1777312468. Notes: regression introduced by v2 quantized variant causing KV reuse regression on long contexts; investigate cache key shaping and kernel path. Assigning to arjun-runtime + infra team.

sally-oncall: good mitigation. I'll hand this to eng-sre for postmortem and monitoring improvements. Oncall status: stable -> continue watch until 15:30 UTC. If p99 rises above 3s again, re-pager.

arjun-runtime: quick checklist for postmortem: capture model profiling traces, full kv cache hit/miss timeline, worker core dumps if any, exact rollout config and canary assignment.

ops-bot: bridge closed by sally-oncall. Duration: 14m.

sally-oncall: thanks all — summary: rollback removed v2, scaled workers, enabled fallback routing; customer impact limited (~4% calls, 2 enterprise tenants with timeouts). Follow-up ticket INF-2026-1777312468 assigned. Reactors: :thumbsup: :eyes:.
